compiler: MSVC x64 Release, asserts ON, LTO OFF
local_settings: Only loopback address/name, min_active_clients=0 and pause_on_join=true; no timeout setting is overridden.
digest: Canonical little-endian database bytes and explicit typed packet/ownership/loading fields; FNV-1a.
timing: Elapsed join, replay GameLoop maximum and Windows process CPU/peaks are distinct. Native linkgraph worker time is included in transport process totals.
teardown: Snapshots and network_error are evaluated before the probe intentionally closes its own processes. Trailing disconnect/recv-failed lines during shutdown are outside that observation.
attempts: complete-long predates the legacy-input buffer allocation guard and commit version stamp; v7 replay behavior is unchanged. initial-rejected-input preserves the native error-state refusal. initial-observation-race compared different StateTicks and is not a same-tick divergence finding. initial-active-timeout records an active client timeout while another probe started concurrently. initial-long uses bounded catch-up before the minimum two-frame video-driver adjustment. stalled-observation-missed did time out at 500 ticks in stdout, but the old probe searched stderr.
